_doc: Resource item sprites for the interface bar, generated at 32x32 (their own takes, not downscales of the pickups). Layers as Pulp Wars' item class: style, camera-icon, class-item-32 (Pulp Wars class-icon with '48 pixels' changed to '32 pixels'), subject. Never the word 'icon' in a prompt (Pixen draws a badge). Colours match the map pickups: gold #f2c230, wood bark #8a5a2c, ore slate #6f7f99, essence violet #a855f7. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.subject: Subject: a small stack of three thick shiny gold coins with one more coin leaning against it, warm bright gold, colour #f2c230 with #b07a10 shadows and one pale yellow glint.

Subject: three chunky cut logs stacked in a little pyramid, two on the bottom and one on top, the cut ends facing the viewer: pale cream-tan cut ends with one darker ring, dull mid-brown bark, colour #8a5a2c with #5a3a1c shadows, not orange.
recipes.negative: axe, tree, leaves, fire, orange, red

recipes.subject: Subject: one big jagged angular chunk of raw iron ore with flat faceted faces, cool slate blue-grey, colour #6f7f99 with #46536b shadows and pale #b9c6d8 lit faces, and two bright silver-white metal glints.
recipes.negative: copper, orange, rust, brown, gold, crystals, gems, pickaxe

recipes.subject: Subject: a cluster of three tall chunky pointed crystals glowing bright violet, colour #a855f7 with #6b21a8 shadows and pale lilac #e9d5ff lit faces.
recipes.negative: teal, cyan, blue, green, orange, red, pink, rock base, soft glow halo

recipes.subject: Subject: a small stack of three thick shiny gold coins with one more coin leaning against it, bright lemon yellow gold like a buttercup, colour #ffd23f with #d99a12 shadows, not orange and not copper, and one white glint.
recipes.negative: sack, chest, person, orange, copper, bronze, red, brown
recipes.notes: item-gold-a came back copper-orange: lemon gold named in words and hex.

recipes.subject: Subject: two chunky blocky lumps of raw iron ore lying side by side, dark charcoal grey, colour #4b5262 with #2e3340 shadows, each crossed by thick bright silver-white metal veins, colour #dfe6ef.
recipes.negative: face, eyes, creature, copper, orange, rust, brown, gold, crystals, gems, pickaxe
recipes.notes: item-ore-a's two glints read as eyes (a rock creature): two lumps, veins instead of glints, face words excluded.

recipes.subject: Subject: three tall chunky pointed crystals standing straight up side by side, glowing bright violet, colour #a855f7 with #6b21a8 shadows and pale lilac #e9d5ff lit faces; the bottoms of the crystals are the lowest thing in the image, with nothing under them.
recipes.negative: base, rock, socket, setting, ring, teal, cyan, blue, green, orange, red, pink, soft glow halo
recipes.notes: item-essence-a stood in a red and teal socket: no base, crystals end at the bottom.

recipes.subject: Change only the colour of the coins: recolour the orange coins to bright lemon yellow gold, colour #ffd23f with #d99a12 shadows and white glints, not orange. Keep the shapes, the outline and the art style exactly the same.
recipes.notes: Recolour edit of item-gold-b#0 (good shape, still orange-gold).
